summary.plain: A liquid-xenon detector buried deep in a New Mexico salt mine that also stores nuclear waste. EXO-200 searched for a rare radioactive process in xenon atoms from 2011 to 2018 and found no signal.
summary.technical: EXO-200 (Enriched Xenon Observatory): cylindrical liquid-xenon time projection chamber (136Xe-enriched to 80.6%) at WIPP, ~655 m underground. Operated 2011-2018 with a pause for a WIPP underground incident unrelated to the experiment; final dataset totalled 234.1 kg·yr exposure, setting T1/2 0ν > 3.5x10^25 yr (90% C.L.). Predecessor to nEXO.
